prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–shipping release; pallets remain inside. Warehouse Management System(Morrowglass): authoritative inventory/tasks/constraints; authorizes moves, prevents duplicates; produces Slot Reservation Receipt/Dispatch Wave Amendment; consumes Oversize Load Advisory/Aisle Occupancy Snapshot/Forklift Handoff Confirmation; closes movements, reconciles recovery/shift records. Yard Gate Controller(Velvetrook): validates vehicles/windows, controls entry/recovery holds; receives Trailer Seal Exception Note. Yard personnel notify receiving of departure-readiness. Inbound Inspection Desk(Cinderbay): identity/seals/documents/counts checks, damage separation, reviewed proceed/rework/hold; sends exception note; receives inspection advisory; records governance approval/change-controlled configuration. Inbound Pallet Buffer≠acceptance. Pallet Dimension Scanner(Moonquarry): produces Oversize Load Advisory; dimensional exceptions held. Allocation requires dimensions/mass/compatibility/clearance/retrievability/restricted-position approval; closure requires count/inspection/door-release records. Conveyor Line Controller(Brasshaven): produces Transfer Induction Ticket; identity/presence/interlocks/readiness/single-admission; inhibits unsafe/duplicate/uncertain induction; checks clear zones/closing completion. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor stop for boundary threats; East restart empty/reduced-speed/full-cycle, recorded authorization/results/alarms. Autonomous Forklift Fleet(Larkspur): receives ticket/recovery-route hold; validates pickup/identity/vehicle/route/destination; pedestrian/access/speed controls; produces handoff confirmation; parks approved locations/reports restrictions. North Aisle Stacker Crane(Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane: separated aisles/controlled crossings/target-clearance checks; obstruction stop, stale-report induction hold, fault inspection. North receives reservation receipt, produces occupancy snapshot; receives Crane Service Release Card after functional/safety checks. Maintenance Release Terminal(Copperfield) produces card, records service/authorization; restrictions visible until cleared. Fire Alarm Panel/Safety Zone Controller retain stop authority; controller isolates/blocks entry, applies Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice. Release checks: faults/bypasses/escalations; boundaries/stop-response; Inbound Inspection Desk/Outbound Dispatch Sorter interfaces/safe holds. Shipping Documentation Desk reconciles Gross Weight Variance Slip; out-of-tolerance variance resolved before shipment release. Shift handover records restrictions/checks/safety concerns; incoming acknowledgment precedes movements. Commissioning: approved test-plan behavior/safety/evidence/blocking criteria;

New part:
S240: Operational performance and recurring faults are reviewed at a defined cadence using retained acceptance and maintenance records.
S241: The review assigns corrective actions with accountable owners, target dates, and evidence of closure.
S242: Training is updated when a change affects operator duties, alarm response, or equipment recovery procedures.
S243: The outgoing shift records remaining restrictions and unresolved concerns, and the incoming shift acknowledges them before authorizing routine movements.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
